summary: The MaintUploadTemplates module allows administrators to view, add, edit, and delete upload templates associated with specific agencies and departments. It provides a web interface with data grid and details view components for managing templates, enforcing field validations, and supporting operations through event-driven workflows.
purpose: To provide a user interface and related server-side functionality for managing upload template definitions (name and number of header rows) for Excel file imports, scoped to agency and department.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Name of the upload template. Mandatory, max length 50.

fields.name: HeaderRows
fields.description: Number of header rows for the Excel (required, must be > 0).

actors.permissions: Can add, edit, and delete upload templates for permitted agencies/departments.

workflows.name: Manage Upload Templates
steps: User selects agency and department from drop-down menus.
Grid displays current templates for selection.
User can add a new template (opens DetailsView in insert mode).
User can edit an existing template (opens DetailsView in edit mode).
User enters template Name and HeaderRows.
Validations run: Name required, HeaderRows required and > 0.
On Save, template is added or updated for the selected agency/department.
User can delete a template with confirmation.
Error and warning panels display issues and messages.

business_rules: Template Name is mandatory and maximum 50 characters.
HeaderRows is mandatory and must be an integer greater than 0.
FileFormat for all templates is fixed as 'Excel'.
Templates are always scoped to both an agency and department.
validations: CompareValidator ensures HeaderRows is a positive integer (>0).
conditions: If AgencyID or DepartmentID is missing or invalid, user cannot proceed.
On insert, default HeaderRows to 1 in DetailsView.
system_behavior: On page load, agency and department dropdowns are populated based on user session or querystring values.
Changing agency reloads department dropdown and templates.
Error and warning messages are handled by panels that can be dismissed by user.
Data is refreshed and grid re-bound after every modification.
dependencies: Grid, Dropdown, and HSPnet UI utilities
exceptions: If Save is attempted with invalid data, validations will prevent submission and errors are shown.
If a deletion fails, error panel displays the issue.
content_gaps: No explicit UI screenshots or end-to-end user examples.
No details on audit logging, security restrictions beyond session-based filtering, or multi-user conflict handling.
Actual UploadTemplateHeader class and methods are referenced but not fully described.
